svg.aria-label: Full XML benchmark results: MB/s per implementation and input
svg.text: MB/s of input, higher is better · bold = best in its group · shading = relative to that best (log scale)
Median of 3-9 processes, until 3 agree within 5% · FAIL = rejected, crashed or a wrong check · DNF = over 60 s · n/a = no UTF-16 support · * see the notes in results.md
